plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-10 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Mathematics - Pure Mathematics Emphasis (BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Mathematics & Mathematics Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Pure Math (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. The catalog prints Total Credits, BS Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (13/16/15/15/16/15/15/15) and the plan to 120. Cross-check: the catalog's Pure Mathematics Curriculum totals 55 credits (Core 40, including one of MATH 4230/MATH 4410 and one programming/discrete course, plus 15 credits of upper-division MATH electives); the map's five upper-division elective slots total exactly those 15 credits, and its Year 3 Fall programming slot is the catalog's CS 1400 / CS 1410 / MATH 2170 / MATH 3150 choice. The catalog notes MATH 1210 can count toward the General Education Quantitative Literacy requirement, and that all major courses must be passed with a C- or better. The map recommends PHYS 2210 and PHYS 2215 for the Year 1 Spring Physical Sciences slot. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
